row.name: Beta Bionics Inc. Common Stock

checks.label: not up two days in a row
checks.threshold: up_run <= 1, counting days above +1.0%; veto at 3+ up closes of any size

checks.label: linearity of the prior leg
checks.threshold: ER >= 0.4 or R2 >= 0.55 (both for A+); failing is a veto

checks.label: young trend: first or second breakout
checks.threshold: prior breakouts since the move started <= 1 (0 for A+)

checks.label: narrow or negative day before
checks.threshold: prior day negative or range < 2.0% (A+: negative and under its 20-session median range)

checks.label: consolidation quality
checks.display: base_sessions=35 breakdowns=9 bursts_in_base=6 giveback=0.85 tightness=0.98 base_volume_vs_leg=0.8 base_volume_vs_avg=0.88
checks.threshold: base 3-20 sessions, breakdowns <= 1, giveback <= 0.34, tightness <= 1.0 (A+: 0 breakdowns, 0 bursts inside, giveback <= 0.25, tightness <= 0.7, base volume under the leg's and the 50-session average)
checks.note: base of 35 sessions is outside Bonde's 3-20; 9 4% breakdowns inside the base; the base gave back 0.85 of the leg

checks.label: close near the high
checks.threshold: close_pos >= 0.8 and close > open (A+ >= 0.9; partial from 0.7)

checks.label: range expansion
checks.threshold: today's range over the largest of the prior 5 >= 1.0 (A+: also over the prior 10)
checks.note: the burst bar is not the widest of the last five

checks.label: higher volume
checks.threshold: volume > prior session (A+: rank <= 3 of the last 60); a base over 21 sessions also needs >= 1.5x the 50-session average
checks.note: base over 21 sessions: +CV applies, volume must be >= 1.5x average and a catalyst is needed, which bars cannot show

notes: extension: close 1.9% vs its 20-SMA, 5.6% over 20 sessions
prior breakouts worked 0 of 3 (closed higher 3 sessions later, last 4 in 60 sessions)

claude.reason: The base is a 35-session declining structure from ~$22 down to ~$14, with 9 recorded 4%-down breakdowns and a giveback of 0.85 of the prior leg — visually the shaded box covers a prolonged downtrend with wide, overlapping red and green bars, not a tight consolidation. On top of that, the burst bar's range (6.4%) is only one-third the size of the prior five bars (vs_prior_5=0.33), meaning there is no genuine range expansion, and volume at 0.72x the 50-session average with a rank of 33/60 is well below the catalyst-volume threshold required for a base this long. Three independent recorded FAILs (C, RE, VOL) and the visually declining base make this a skip.
claude.key_risk: The base is a multi-month downtrend, not a consolidation, and a 7.8% burst without range expansion or elevated volume into a declining structure has a high probability of failing immediately.
claude.entry_note: Skip at the open if price gaps below the prior close or opens with a weak bid and no volume surge in the first 15 minutes, confirming the burst has no follow-through.
